description: Human-readable interface record. Training reads the robot YAML and package_posttrain YAML, not this JSON.

layout.padding_note: 75 is the model padding limit, not the number of physical joints. Preserve the 16 raw dimensions in the order above.

actions.episode_boundary: Never query another episode. Mark out-of-bound horizon steps; current dataset behavior holds the final target.
actions.execution_horizon: A separate deployment choice; predicting 50 steps does not require executing all 50 before observing again.

requirements: Fit statistics after applying the robot mapping and arm state subtraction.
Record training source identities, dataset version and horizon with the statistics.
Use the same statistics for training, evaluation and deployment.
Do not reuse 25-step arm statistics for this 50-step contract.

task.instruction: Pick a soft package from the box, orient its label upward, and place it on the conveyor belt.
task.source: main VLADataset.getdata: episode annotation overrides LeRobot task table when a label record exists
task.policy: Preserve main behavior: grasp_label_up true selects keep-up prompt; false selects flip prompt; missing episode record retains dataset task.

fps.validation: Require finite positive FPS, camera video FPS consistency and timestamp spacing consistent with metadata. A different rate requires an explicit contract revision or documented resampling; do not silently assume 30.

identity.split_rule: All complete, cropped or reindexed versions of a source_episode_id must stay in one split.
identity.missing_identity: Resolve source provenance before splitting; a local episode_index is not a source identity.

alignment_checks: State and action vectors have 16 finite values in the specified order.
All three RGB streams correspond to the same observation timestamp.
Frame and global indices agree with episode boundaries and loaded row order.
